f.title: Do not omit any section of the RPS structure
f.statement: Because the guide is based on NOM-220-SSA1-2016 and international regulations, none of the points in the structure established for the preparation of the RPS shall be omitted.

rows.actor: Health registration holder, its legal representative in Mexico or orphan-medicine recognition holder
rows.quote: Esta guía está elaborada con base a lo establecido en la NOM-220-SSA1-2016, instalación y operación de la farmacovigilancia y sus modificaciones, así como, en la reglamentación internacional, por lo cual no se deberá omitir ninguno de los puntos en la estructura establecida para la elaboración del RPS.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'no se deberá omitir' = Mandatory; impersonal or subjectless 'deberá(n)'; submitter (holder/representative/orphan holder) inferred, not named in the quote.
rows.quote_en: This guide is prepared on the basis of NOM-220-SSA1-2016, installation and operation of pharmacovigilance and its amendments, as well as international regulations, so none of the points in the structure established for the preparation of the RPS shall be omitted.

f.title: Justify within the section any RPS section left without information
f.statement: If no information is available for any section of the RPS, the justification for omitting it must be written within that same section.

rows.actor: Health registration holder, its legal representative in Mexico or orphan-medicine recognition holder
rows.quote: 4.1 En caso de no contar con información para alguno de los apartados que conforman el RPS, es necesario que dentro del mismo punto se redacte la justificación correspondiente de la omisión de dicha información.

rows.quote_en: 4.1 If no information is available for any of the sections making up the RPS, it is necessary that the corresponding justification for the omission of that information be written within the same point.

f.title: Submit the RPS electronically (CD/USB), not on paper
f.statement: The RPS must be submitted in electronic format (CD/USB); the information shall not be filed on paper.

rows.actor: Health registration holder, its legal representative in Mexico or orphan-medicine recognition holder
rows.quote: 4.2 El RPS debe someterse en formato electrónico (CD/USB), por lo que no deberá ingresar la información en papel.

rows.quote_en: 4.2 The RPS must be submitted in electronic format (CD/USB), so the information shall not be filed on paper.

f.title: RPS signed by the CNFV-accredited head of the Pharmacovigilance Unit
f.statement: The RPS shall bear the signature of the person responsible for the Pharmacovigilance Unit, who shall be duly accredited by the CNFV.

rows.actor: Health registration holder, its legal representative in Mexico or orphan-medicine recognition holder
rows.quote: 4.3 El RPS deberá contar con la firma del responsable de la unidad de Farmacovigilancia, quien deberá estar debidamente acreditado por el CNFV.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'deberá' with the RPS/document as subject; submitter unambiguous from the guide's scope; statement matches quote.
rows.quote_en: 4.3 The RPS shall bear the signature of the person responsible for the Pharmacovigilance Unit, who shall be duly accredited by the CNFV.

f.title: Write the RPS in Spanish in the sections where required
f.statement: The RPS shall be in Spanish in the sections where this is requested (see Annex 1, RPS compliance table).

rows.actor: Health registration holder, its legal representative in Mexico or orphan-medicine recognition holder
rows.quote: 4.4 El RPS deberá estar en idioma español en las secciones que se solicitan como tal. Para mayor información ver Anexo 1. Tabla de cumplimientos de RPS.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'deberá' with the RPS/document as subject; submitter unambiguous from the guide's scope; statement matches quote.
rows.quote_en: 4.4 The RPS shall be in Spanish in the sections requested as such. For more information see Annex 1. RPS compliance table.

f.title: Submit the RPS with a cover letter via CIS containing the required product and period data
f.statement: To submit an RPS, a free-format letter shall be delivered through the Comprehensive Services Centre (CIS) addressed to the Executive Directorate of Pharmacopoeia and Pharmacovigilance, containing: generic and distinctive names; pharmaceutical form; health registration number with fraction (or orphan recognition number); RPS number; revision number (when applicable); period covered (dd/mm/yyyy); whether a non-marketing format was filed before this RPS and, if so, the non-marketing period; and the electronic format (CD/USB).

rows.actor: Health registration holder, its legal representative in Mexico or orphan-medicine recognition holder
rows.quote: Para el sometimiento de los RPS, se deberá entregar un escrito libre a través del Centro Integral de Servicios (CIS) dirigido a la Dirección Ejecutiva de Farmacopea y Farmacovigilancia, el cual deberá contener la siguiente información técnica indispensable:  Denominación genérica del medicamento o vacuna.  Denominación distintiva del medicamento o vacuna.  Forma farmacéutica del medicamento o vacuna.  Número de Registro Sanitario con la fracción o número de reconocimiento en caso de medicamento huérfano.  Número de RPS que corresponde.  Número de revisión correspondiente (cuando aplique).  Periodo que comprende el RPS (dd/mm/aaaa).  Informar si cuenta con un formato de no comercialización previo al sometimiento de este RPS, en caso afirmativo indicar el periodo de no comercialización.  Formato electrónico en que se somete el trámite (CD/USB).
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'se deberá entregar'/'deberá contener' = Mandatory; impersonal or subjectless 'deberá(n)'; submitter (holder/representative/orphan holder) inferred, not named in the quote.
rows.quote_en: For submission of RPSs, a free-format letter shall be delivered through the Comprehensive Services Centre (CIS) addressed to the Executive Directorate of Pharmacopoeia and Pharmacovigilance, which shall contain the following indispensable technical information: Generic name of the medicine or vaccine. Distinctive name of the medicine or vaccine. Pharmaceutical form of the medicine or vaccine. Health registration number with fraction, or recognition number in the case of an orphan medicine. Corresponding RPS number. Corresponding revision number (when applicable). Period covered by the RPS (dd/mm/yyyy). State whether a non-marketing format was filed prior to submission of this RPS and, if so, indicate the non-marketing period. Electronic format in which the procedure is submitted (CD/USB).

f.title: Include current PV unit and responsible-person details, with handwritten signature, in the cover letter
f.statement: The cover letter shall include complete details of the Pharmacovigilance Unit and of the person responsible for pharmacovigilance, updated and current before the CNFV, including the name and handwritten signature of the person responsible for the Pharmacovigilance Unit.

rows.actor: Health registration holder, its legal representative in Mexico or orphan-medicine recognition holder
rows.quote:  Datos completos de la unidad y del responsable de farmacovigilancia (actualizados y vigentes ante el CNFV) que incluyan:  Nombre y firma autógrafa del responsable de la Unidad de Farmacovigilancia
data_elements: PV responsible person name and signature

rows.quote_en: Complete details of the unit and of the person responsible for pharmacovigilance (updated and current before the CNFV) including: Name and handwritten signature of the person responsible for the Pharmacovigilance Unit

f.title: Present the RPS electronically, in Spanish, with the prescribed section structure
f.statement: The holder, legal representative or orphan-medicine recognition holder, through the person responsible for the pharmacovigilance unit, shall present the RPS in electronic format and in Spanish (in the applicable fields), containing the prescribed sections, starting with: cover page, executive summary, table of contents, introduction, national and international authorisation status, regulatory actions for safety reasons, changes to reference safety information, estimated exposure, and cumulative case summary tables (sections 6.1-6.9 quoted; further sections follow).

rows.actor: Health registration holder, its legal representative in Mexico or orphan-medicine recognition holder
rows.quote: El titular de registro sanitario, el representante legal o el titular del oficio de reconocimiento como medicamento huérfano en México a través del responsable de unidad de farmacovigilancia deberá de presentar el RPS en formato electrónico, en idioma español (en los campos que aplique) y contener la siguiente información: 6.1 Portada. 6.2 Resumen ejecutivo. 6.3 Tabla de contenidos. 6.4 Introducción. 6.5 Estado de la autorización en el mercado nacional e internacional. 6.6 Actualización de las acciones tomadas por las autoridades reguladoras por razones de seguridad. 6.7 Cambios a la información de referencia de seguridad del producto. 6.8 Estimación de pacientes expuestos. 6.9 Tabla resumen de casos individuales de SRAM, RAM, EA, ESAVI o cualquier otro problema de seguridad relacionado al uso de los medicamentos y vacunas, acumulados.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'deberá de presentar' = Mandatory; actor named in the quote; statement matches quote.
rows.quote_en: The health registration holder, the legal representative or the holder of the orphan-medicine recognition in Mexico, through the person responsible for the pharmacovigilance unit, shall present the RPS in electronic format, in Spanish (in the applicable fields), and it shall contain the following information: 6.1 Cover page. 6.2 Executive summary. 6.3 Table of contents. 6.4 Introduction. 6.5 National and international marketing authorisation status. 6.6 Update on actions taken by regulatory authorities for safety reasons. 6.7 Changes to the product's reference safety information. 6.8 Estimate of exposed patients. 6.9 Cumulative summary table of individual cases of SRAM, RAM, EA, ESAVI or any other safety problem related to the use of medicines and vaccines. [...]

f.title: International companies may cross-reference or partially translate the international RPS
f.statement: International companies may cross-reference some sections of the national RPS to the international one and partially translate information from the international RPS, provided it complies with the guide.
f.applicability: Companies attaching an international periodic report (PSUR/PBRER).
f.exceptions: Must comply with what is requested in the guide (see Annex I).

rows.actor: Health registration holder, its legal representative in Mexico or orphan-medicine recognition holder
rows.quote: Nota Las empresas internacionales podrán realizar lo siguiente: • Referenciar algunos apartados del RPS nacional al internacional. • Traducir información de forma parcial del RPS internacional, siempre y cuando cumpla con lo solicitado en esta guía.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'podrán' = Permitted; actor named in the quote; statement matches quote.
rows.quote_en: Note: International companies may do the following: Cross-reference some sections of the national RPS to the international one. Partially translate information from the international RPS, provided it complies with what is requested in this guide.

f.title: RPS cover page on holder letterhead with product, period, exposure and notification counts
f.statement: The RPS cover page shall be on the health registration holder's letterhead and include: generic and distinctive names; pharmaceutical form and presentation(s); health registration number with fraction (recognition number for orphan medicines); period covered (dd/mm/yyyy); date marketing started in Mexico; number of patients exposed in the period; and number of notifications sent to the CNFV in the RPS period.

rows.actor: Health registration holder, its legal representative in Mexico or orphan-medicine recognition holder
rows.quote: La portada del RPS deberá presentarse en hoja membretada por el titular de Registro Sanitario, incluyendo lo siguiente:  Denominación genérica del medicamento o vacuna.  Denominación distintiva del medicamento o vacuna.  Forma Farmacéutica y presentación(es) del medicamento o vacuna.  Número de Registro Sanitario con fracción (para medicamentos huérfanos deberá colocar el número de reconocimiento).  Periodo de tiempo que cubre el RPS (dd/mm/aaaa).  Fecha de inicio de comercialización en México.  Número de pacientes expuestos en el periodo.  Número de notificaciones enviadas al CNFV en el periodo del RPS que está sometiendo.
data_elements: number of notifications sent to CNFV
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'La portada ... deberá' = Mandatory; 'deberá' with the RPS/document as subject; submitter unambiguous from the guide's scope; statement matches quote.
rows.quote_en: The RPS cover page shall be presented on the health registration holder's letterhead, including the following: Generic name of the medicine or vaccine. Distinctive name of the medicine or vaccine. Pharmaceutical form and presentation(s) of the medicine or vaccine. Health registration number with fraction (for orphan medicines the recognition number shall be given). Period of time covered by the RPS (dd/mm/yyyy). Date of start of marketing in Mexico. Number of patients exposed in the period. Number of notifications sent to the CNFV in the period of the RPS being submitted.

f.title: Executive summary in Spanish, maximum 2 pages
f.statement: The executive summary gives, in Spanish and in at most 2 pages, the most important information of each RPS section; where an international RPS exists, its summary shall be translated and placed here provided it meets this point.

rows.actor: Health registration holder, its legal representative in Mexico or orphan-medicine recognition holder
rows.quote: Esta sección tiene como finalidad proporcionar un resumen en español de la información más importante de cada uno de los apartados del RPS máximo 2 cuartillas. Por lo que en caso de contar con un RPS internacional se deberá realizar la traducción del mismo y colocarlo en esta sección siempre y cuando cumpla con lo solicitado en este punto.

rows.quote_en: This section is intended to provide a summary in Spanish of the most important information of each of the sections of the RPS, maximum 2 pages. Therefore, if an international RPS is available, its translation shall be made and placed in this section provided it complies with what is requested in this point.

f.title: Paginated table of contents covering all national RPS sections only
f.statement: A paginated, linked index shall include all sections of the national RPS; no paginated index shall be made of the information in the international RPS, because information referenced to the international RPS shall appear within each section of the national RPS.

rows.actor: Health registration holder, its legal representative in Mexico or orphan-medicine recognition holder
rows.quote: En este apartado se realizará un índice paginado, que vincule a la sección a la que haga referencia el cual deberá incluir todas las secciones que comprenden el RPS nacional. No se deberá realizar un índice paginado sobre la información disponible en el RPS internacional. Ya que la información referenciada al RPS internacional deberá estar en cada uno de los apartados que comprende el RPS nacional.

rows.quote_en: In this section a paginated index will be made, linking to the section it refers to, which shall include all the sections comprising the national RPS. A paginated index of the information available in the international RPS shall not be made, since the information referenced to the international RPS shall be in each of the sections comprising the national RPS.

f.title: Introduction: indications, target population and posology authorised in Mexico
f.statement: The introduction shall briefly describe the therapeutic indication(s) and target population authorised in Mexico, therapeutic group, mechanism(s) of action, route of administration, pharmaceutical form and posology by age group (dose with units, frequency and period of administration).

rows.actor: Health registration holder, its legal representative in Mexico or orphan-medicine recognition holder
rows.quote: Dentro de este apartado, se deberá incluir una breve descripción de la indicación(es) terapéutica(s) y de la población diana autorizada en México.  Indicación(es) terapéutica(s)  Población diana autorizada en México.  Grupo terapéutico.  Mecanismo(s) de acción.  Vía de administración.  Forma farmacéutica.  Posología por grupo etario (dosis incluyendo unidades, frecuencia de administración y periodo de administración).
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'se deberá incluir' = Mandatory; impersonal or subjectless 'deberá(n)'; submitter (holder/representative/orphan holder) inferred, not named in the quote.
rows.quote_en: Within this section, a brief description of the therapeutic indication(s) and of the target population authorised in Mexico shall be included. Therapeutic indication(s). Target population authorised in Mexico. Therapeutic group. Mechanism(s) of action. Route of administration. Pharmaceutical form. Posology by age group (dose including units, frequency of administration and period of administration).

f.title: Translate the international introduction or prepare one for Mexico
f.statement: Companies attaching an international report shall translate this section into Spanish if the international RPS meets this point; otherwise they must prepare an introduction for Mexico.
f.applicability: Companies attaching an international periodic report (PSUR/PBRER).

rows.actor: Health registration holder, its legal representative in Mexico or orphan-medicine recognition holder
rows.quote: Nota: Para empresas que anexen un reporte internacional deberán realizar la traducción al idioma español de este apartado siempre y cuando el RPS internacional cumpla con lo solicitado en este punto, de lo contrario tendrán que elaborar una introducción para México.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'deberán' = Mandatory; actor named in the quote; statement matches quote.
rows.quote_en: Note: Companies attaching an international report shall translate this section into Spanish provided the international RPS complies with what is requested in this point; otherwise they will have to prepare an introduction for Mexico.

f.title: Describe authorisation status in each country with registration (Table I)
f.statement: The authorisation status shall be described for each country where the medicine or vaccine holds a health registration for marketing, including at least the points in Table I.

rows.location: 6.5 Estado de la autorización en el mercado nacional e internacional

rows.quote_en: It shall describe the authorisation status of each country where the medicine or vaccine has a health registration for marketing, which shall include at a minimum the points indicated in Table I.

f.title: International reports: Table I with Mexico data only, page references, own-registration countries
f.statement: A company with an international report shall fill in Table I only with Mexico information and state the page number(s) of the international report where the international authorisation status is found; Table I is filled only with countries where it is the registration holder or legal representative.
f.clause: 6.5 Estado de la autorización en el mercado nacional e internacional
f.applicability: Companies attaching an international periodic report (PSUR/PBRER).

rows.actor: Health registration holder, its legal representative in Mexico or orphan-medicine recognition holder
rows.quote: La empresa que cuente con un reporte internacional, deberá llenar la tabla I solo con información referente a México y especificar dentro de esta sección: el número de página(s) donde se encuentre la información correspondiente en el reporte internacional sobre el estado de autorización a nivel internacional. Nota: para la tabla I solo deberá llenarse con información de los países donde sea titular del registro sanitario o representante legal del medicamento o vacuna en cuestión.
rows.location: 6.5 Estado de la autorización en el mercado nacional e internacional
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'deberá' = Mandatory; actor named in the quote; statement matches quote.
rows.quote_en: The company that has an international report shall fill in Table I only with information on Mexico and specify within this section the page number(s) where the corresponding information on international authorisation status is found in the international report. Note: Table I shall only be filled in with information on the countries where it is the health registration holder or legal representative of the medicine or vaccine in question.

f.title: Describe regulatory actions taken for safety reasons, investigational and marketed
f.statement: The RPS shall describe actions requested or taken by national and international regulatory authorities in the investigational stages and during marketing; for an approved, marketed product being studied for new indications, populations or conditions of use, state whether any of the listed authority actions has been taken.
f.clause: 6.6 Actualización de las acciones tomadas por las autoridades reguladoras por razones de seguridad

rows.quote: Esta sección se deberá describir las acciones solicitadas o realizadas por autoridades regulatorias a nivel nacional e internacional, en las etapas de investigación y durante la comercialización. 6.6.1. rows.quote: La empresa que anexe un reporte internacional deberá proporcionar la información solicitada en idioma español. Por lo que se deberá realizar la traducción de la información disponible en su reporte internacional.

f.clause: 6.7 Cambios a la información de referencia de seguridad del producto

rows.actor: Health registration holder, its legal representative in Mexico or orphan-medicine recognition holder
rows.quote: Dentro de este apartado se deberá de especificar los cambios en el contenido de la IPPA autorizada en México, realizados durante el periodo que cubre el RPS. rows.location: 6.7 Cambios a la información de referencia de seguridad del producto

f.title: International reports: Table II in Spanish with Mexico data and page references

f.clause: 6.7 Cambios a la información de referencia de seguridad del producto
f.applicability: Companies attaching an international periodic report (PSUR/PBRER).

rows.actor: Health registration holder, its legal representative in Mexico or orphan-medicine recognition holder
rows.quote: La empresa que cuente con un reporte internacional, deberá llenar la tabla II en idioma español solo con información referente a México y especificar dentro de esta sección: página(s) y sección(es) donde se encuentre la información correspondiente en el reporte internacional sobre cambios a la información de referencia de seguridad del producto a nivel internacional.
rows.location: 6.7 Cambios a la información de referencia de seguridad del producto
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'deberá' = Mandatory; actor named in the quote; statement matches quote.
rows.quote_en: The company that has an international report shall fill in Table II in Spanish only with information on Mexico and specify within this section the page(s) and section(s) where the corresponding information on changes to the product's reference safety information at international level is found in the international report.

f.title: Exposure section in Spanish with Mexico data in Tables III-VI

rows.actor: Health registration holder, its legal representative in Mexico or orphan-medicine recognition holder

rows.quote_en: This section shall be presented in Spanish, filling in only Tables III, IV, V and VI (as applicable) with information on Mexico.

f.title: Use consistent, justified methods to calculate patient exposure
f.statement: Consistent methods shall be used to calculate subject/patient exposure where possible; they shall be described and justified in detail, together with their limitations.

rows.actor: Health registration holder, its legal representative in Mexico or orphan-medicine recognition holder

f.title: Treat new clinically important information on closed signals as new signals; tabulate in Table XI
f.statement: Signals may derive from qualitative or quantitative processes. New clinically important information on an already closed signal arising during the RPS period also constitutes a new signal, as do clinically significant changes in risk seriousness, increased frequency of an identified risk, or a potential risk that, if confirmed, could justify a new warning, precaution, restriction or other risk minimisation. La nueva información de importancia clínica de una señal ya cerrada, derivada durante el periodo de presentación del RPS, también constituirá una nueva señal, otros ejemplos incluyen:  Cambios clínicamente significativos en la gravedad del riesgo.  Aumento en la frecuencia del riesgo identificado.  Riesgo potencial que, si se confirma, podría justificar una nueva advertencia, precaución o restricción en la indicación, en la población u otras actividades de minimización de riesgos. Dicha información deberá presentarse como se solicita en la tabla XI.

Increase in the frequency of the identified risk. A potential risk that, if confirmed, could justify a new warning, precaution or restriction in the indication, the population or other risk minimisation activities. This information shall be presented as requested in Table XI.

f.title: Summarise important safety concerns during the RPS interval
f.statement: The important safety concerns during the interval covered by the RPS shall be presented: important identified risks, important potential risks and missing information considered important.

rows.actor: Health registration holder, its legal representative in Mexico or orphan-medicine recognition holder
rows.quote: Dentro de esta subsección se deberán presentar las preocupaciones de seguridad importantes durante el intervalo cubierto por el RPS:  Riesgos identificados importantes.  Riesgos potenciales importantes.  Información faltante que se considere importante.

f.title: Consider seriousness, frequency, public health impact and risk perception when rating importance
f.statement: When determining the importance of each risk, the following shall be considered: medical seriousness (including impact on individual patients); frequency, predictability and reversibility; potential public health impact; and potential for avoidance of a product with preventive benefit due to disproportionate public perception of the risk (e.g. vaccines).

rows.actor: Health registration holder, its legal representative in Mexico or orphan-medicine recognition holder
rows.quote: Los siguientes factores deberán de ser considerados al determinar la importancia de cada riesgo:  Gravedad médica del riesgo (incluyendo el impacto en pacientes individuales).  Frecuencia, previsibilidad y reversibilidad.  Impacto potencial en la salud pública (frecuencia; tamaño de la población tratada).  Potencial para evitar el uso del producto medicinal con un beneficio preventivo debido a la desproporcionada percepción pública del riesgo (por ejemplo, vacunas).
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'deberán de ser considerados' = Mandatory; impersonal or subjectless 'deberá(n)'; submitter (holder/representative/orphan holder) inferred, not named in the quote.
rows.quote_en: The following factors shall be considered when determining the importance of each risk: Medical seriousness of the risk (including the impact on individual patients). Frequency, predictability and reversibility. Potential impact on public health (frequency; size of the treated population). Potential for avoiding use of the medicinal product with a preventive benefit due to disproportionate public perception of the risk (for example, vaccines).

f.title: Report evaluation results of all signals closed during the interval
f.statement: The results of evaluations of all safety signals (important or not) closed during the RPS interval shall be reported; a signal may be closed because it is refuted or determined to be a potential or identified risk.

A safety signal may be closed because it is refuted or because it is determined to be a potential or identified risk, after evaluation.

f.title: Describe the basis for refuting or confirming each closed signal
f.statement: For both categories of closed signals (refuted, or categorised as potential or identified risks), a concise description of each signal evaluation shall be included, clearly describing the basis on which the holder refuted the signal or considered it a risk.

f.title: Scale signal-evaluation detail to medical and public health significance
f.statement: It is recommended that the level of detail of each signal-evaluation description reflect the signal's medical significance, potential public health importance and the extent of available evidence.

rows.actor: Health registration holder, its legal representative in Mexico or orphan-medicine recognition holder
rows.quote: Se recomienda que el nivel de detalle proporcionado en la descripción de la evaluación de la señal refleje la significancia médica de la señal (por ejemplo, severa, irreversible, conduce a un incremento en la morbilidad o mortalidad) y la potencial importancia para la salud pública (por ejemplo, uso amplio, frecuencia, uso fuera de las recomendaciones en la información del producto) y el alcance de la evidencia disponible.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'Se recomienda' = Recommended; impersonal, submitter inferred.
rows.quote_en: It is recommended that the level of detail provided in the description of the signal evaluation reflect the medical significance of the signal (for example, severe, irreversible, leading to increased morbidity or mortality) and the potential public health importance (for example, wide use, frequency, use outside the recommendations in the product information) and the extent of the available evidence.

f.title: Signal-evaluation descriptions: source, background, methods, results, discussion, conclusion
f.statement: Per the 6.19.2 lead-in ("shall include the following information, as appropriate"), a signal-evaluation description covers: source or trigger; relevant background; evaluation methods including data sources, search criteria (MedDRA terms or SMQs where applicable) and analytical approaches; results with a summary and critical analysis (which may include a case series or index case); discussion; and conclusion.

rows.actor: Health registration holder, its legal representative in Mexico or orphan-medicine recognition holder
rows.quote:  Fuente o disparador de la señal.  Antecedentes relevantes para la evaluación.  Métodos de evaluación, incluyendo fuentes de información, criterios de búsqueda [cuando aplique, términos MedDRA específicos (por ejemplo PT, HLT y SOC, entre otros), o preguntas estandarizadas de MedDRA (SMQ) que fueron revisadas] y enfoques analíticos.  Resultados, incluyendo un resumen y análisis crítico de los datos considerados en la evaluación de señales; cuando sea parte integral de la evaluación, puede incluir una descripción de una serie de casos o un caso individual (por ejemplo, un caso índice de agranulocitosis bien documentada, o síndrome de Stevens Johnson).  Discusión.  Conclusión.

Evaluation methods, including information sources, search criteria [where applicable, specific MedDRA terms (for example PT, HLT and SOC, among others), or Standardised MedDRA Queries (SMQ) that were reviewed] and analytical approaches. Results, including a summary and critical analysis of the data considered in the signal evaluation; where integral to the evaluation, it may include a description of a case series or an individual case (for example, a well-documented index case of agranulocytosis, or Stevens-Johnson syndrome). Discussion. Conclusion.

f.statement: Evaluations of new information and updates of missing information may be included in this section; each evaluation shall include, as appropriate: source of new information, background, methods (data sources, search criteria, analytical approaches), results, discussion, and a conclusion stating whether it supports updating the characterisation of any potential or identified risk.

f.title: Characterise important risks on cumulative data (frequency, numerator, denominator, relative and absolute risk)
f.statement: Important identified and potential risks shall be characterised on cumulative information (not restricted to the interval) and missing information described; depending on the data source, characterisation shall include where applicable: frequency; number of cases (numerator) and precision; extent of use (denominator) and precision; relative and absolute risk estimates with precision; impact on the individual patient; and public health impact.

rows.actor: Health registration holder, its legal representative in Mexico or orphan-medicine recognition holder
rows.quote: Dentro de esta subsección, deberán caracterizar los riesgos identificados y potenciales importantes basados en información acumulada (ejemplo: no restringida al intervalo del reporte), y describir la información faltante. Dependiendo de la naturaleza de la fuente de la información, la caracterización del riesgo deberá incluir (cuando aplique):  Frecuencia.  Número de casos (numerador) y precisión de la estimación, teniendo en consideración la fuente de los datos.  Extensión de uso (denominador) expresado como número de pacientes, pacientes-tiempo, etc., y precisión de la estimación.  Estimación del riesgo relativo y precisión de la estimación.  Estimación del riesgo absoluto y precisión de la estimación.  Impacto en el paciente individual (efecto en síntomas, calidad o cantidad de vida).  Impacto en la salud pública.

rows.quote_en: Within this subsection, they shall characterise the important identified and potential risks based on cumulative information (e.g. not restricted to the report interval), and describe the missing information. Depending on the nature of the information source, the risk characterisation shall include (when applicable): Frequency. Number of cases (numerator) and precision of the estimate, taking into account the data source. Extent of use (denominator) expressed as number of patients, patient-time, etc., and precision of the estimate. Estimate of relative risk and precision of the estimate. Estimate of absolute risk and precision of the estimate. Impact on the individual patient (effect on symptoms, quality or quantity of life). Impact on public health.

f.title: Characterise risks: patient factors, dose, duration, preventability, reversibility, mechanism, evidence strength
f.statement: Per the 6.19.4 lead-in, risk characterisation also covers, where applicable: patient characteristics relevant to the risk; dose and route; duration of treatment and risk period; preventability; reversibility; potential mechanism; and strength of evidence and uncertainties, including analysis of conflicting evidence.

rows.quote:  Características de los pacientes relevantes para el riesgo, por ejemplo: factores del paciente (edad, embarazo/lactancia, insuficiencia hepática/renal, comorbilidades relevantes, severidad de la enfermedad, polimorfismo genético).  Dosis, vía de administración.  Duración del tratamiento, periodo de riesgo.  Prevención del riesgo, ejemplo: predictibilidad, capacidad para monitorear una reacción adversa “centinela” o marcador de laboratorio.  Reversibilidad.  Mecanismo potencial.  Fuerza de la evidencia y sus incertidumbres, incluyendo el análisis de evidencia contradictoria, si aplica.

f.statement: The baseline and new information on benefits supporting the benefit/risk evaluation shall be specified; the efficacy and effectiveness information known during the RPS period on which the benefit evaluation rests shall be presented, related to the indication authorised in Mexico and characterised individually by indication, population or route where relevant.

This information shall be related to the therapeutic indication of the medicine or vaccine authorised in Mexico; if there are several indications, populations or routes of administration, the information shall be characterised individually by these factors, where relevant.

f.title: Include new efficacy/effectiveness information from the period

rows.actor: Health registration holder, its legal representative in Mexico or orphan-medicine recognition holder

f.title: Give an overall benefit-risk evaluation including medical need and alternatives
f.statement: The RPS shall include an overall benefit/risk evaluation as used in clinical practice, including a brief description of the medical need in the authorised indications and a summary of treatment alternatives (medical, surgical, other or none).

rows.quote: Dentro de esta sección, deberán incluir una evaluación general de la relación beneficio/riesgo del medicamento o vacuna, tal como se utiliza en la práctica clínica. 6.22.1. Contexto beneficio/riesgo – necesidad médica y alternativas importantes Dentro de esta subsección, deberán proporcionar una breve descripción de la necesidad médica del medicamento o vacuna en las indicaciones autorizadas, incluyendo un resumen de las alternativas al tratamiento (médico, quirúrgico, otros o ningún tratamiento).

Benefit/risk context – medical need and important alternatives. Within this subsection, they shall provide a brief description of the medical need for the medicine or vaccine in the authorised indications, including a summary of treatment alternatives (medical, surgical, other or no treatment).

f.title: Evaluate benefit-risk separately for each Mexican indication and, where needed, population
f.statement: The benefit/risk evaluation is specific to each indication and population: for products with more than one indication authorised in Mexico, balances shall be evaluated and presented individually per indication; where balances differ importantly between populations within an indication, the evaluation shall be presented by population if possible.

rows.actor: Health registration holder, its legal representative in Mexico or orphan-medicine recognition holder
rows.quote: Dentro de esta subsección, deberán proporcionar una evaluación del balance beneficio/riesgo es específico para cada indicación y población. Por lo tanto, para los medicamentos o vacunas con más de una indicación terapéutica autorizada en México, los balances beneficio/riesgo deberán ser evaluados y presentados de forma individual para cada indicación. Si existen diferencias importantes en el balance beneficio/riesgo entre las poblaciones dentro de una indicación, la evaluación beneficio/riesgo deberá ser presentada por población, si es posible.

rows.quote_en: Within this subsection, they shall provide an evaluation of the benefit/risk balance, which is specific to each indication and population. Therefore, for medicines or vaccines with more than one therapeutic indication authorised in Mexico, the benefit/risk balances shall be evaluated and presented individually for each indication. If there are important differences in the benefit/risk balance between populations within an indication, the benefit/risk evaluation shall be presented by population, if possible.

f.title: Present benefit-risk to facilitate comparison: context, benefit and risk importance
f.statement: The benefit/risk evaluation shall be presented to facilitate comparison of benefits and risks, considering: relevant risk and benefit information; the context of use; for benefit, its nature, clinical importance, duration and generalisability, and efficacy in non-responders to other therapies; and for risk, its clinical importance (nature of toxicity, seriousness, frequency, preventability, reversibility, impact, off-label use, new use or misuse).

rows.actor: Health registration holder, its legal representative in Mexico or orphan-medicine recognition holder
rows.quote: La evaluación beneficio/riesgo deberá ser presentada y discutida de manera tal que facilite la comparación de beneficios y riesgos, para lo cual se deberán considerar los siguientes puntos: 1. La información relevante sobre los riesgos y beneficios. 2. El contexto de uso del medicamento o vacuna (condición a ser tratada, prevenida o diagnosticada; su intensidad y gravedad así como la población a ser tratada). 3. Con respecto al beneficio, se deberá tener en cuenta su naturaleza, importancia clínica, duración y grado de generalización, así como también la evidencia de la eficacia en los pacientes que no responden a otras terapias o tratamientos alternativos. 4. Con respecto al riesgo, considere su importancia clínica, por ejemplo: naturaleza de la toxicidad, gravedad, frecuencia, grado en el que se puede prevenir, reversibilidad, impacto en los pacientes, usos fuera de las indicaciones aprobadas, nuevo uso o mal uso.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'deberá'/'se deberán' = Mandatory; impersonal or subjectless 'deberá(n)'; submitter (holder/representative/orphan holder) inferred, not named in the quote.
rows.quote_en: The benefit/risk evaluation shall be presented and discussed in a way that facilitates comparison of benefits and risks, for which the following points shall be considered: 1. The relevant information on risks and benefits. 2. The context of use of the medicine or vaccine (condition to be treated, prevented or diagnosed; its intensity and seriousness as well as the population to be treated). 3. Regarding benefit, its nature, clinical importance, duration and degree of generalisation shall be taken into account, as well as evidence of efficacy in patients not responding to other therapies or alternative treatments. 4. Regarding risk, consider its clinical importance, for example: nature of the toxicity, seriousness, frequency, degree to which it can be prevented, reversibility, impact on patients, off-label uses, new use or misuse.

f.title: Address evidence uncertainty and explain benefit-risk methodology
f.statement: Strengths, weaknesses and uncertainty of the evidence shall be considered, describing how uncertainty affects the evaluation; a clear explanation of the methodology and reasoning shall be provided, with clear assumptions, considerations and weighting, and a summary of methods if a formal quantitative or semi-quantitative evaluation is given.

Se deberá proporcionar una explicación clara de la metodología y el razonamiento utilizado para desarrollar la evaluación beneficio/riesgo: 6.1. Los supuestos, las consideraciones y el juicio o ponderación que apoyan las conclusiones de la evaluación beneficio-riesgo, deben ser claros. 6.2. Si se proporciona una evaluación formal cuantitativa o semicuantitativa del beneficio-riesgo, deberá incluirse un resumen de los métodos.

f.title: Provide a detailed cumulative benefit-risk analysis for authority-requested RPSs
f.statement: When important new information is requested or a specific RPS has been requested by the health authority, a detailed analysis of benefits and risks on cumulative data must be presented; when little new information is available, the evaluation may focus on updated interval safety data.

Por el contrario, cuando se dispone de poca información nueva durante el intervalo de presentación de reportes, el enfoque principal de la evaluación riesgo-beneficio puede consistir en una evaluación de los datos actualizados sobre la seguridad de los intervalos.
